predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: Jing Province under Liu Biao, 'covering present-day Hubei and Hunan'

successors.name: Cao Cao
successors.text: Nanyang, Xiangyang and Nanxiang, kept by Cao Cao after 209

successors.name: Eastern Wu
successors.text: Jiangxia, Guiyang and Changsha, to Sun Quan

successors.name: Shu Han
successors.text: Nan, Lingling and Wuling, to Liu Bei

rulers.name: Liu Biao
rulers.title: Inspector 190-192, then Governor of Jing Province

ledger.x: 208: Liu Biao dies and Jing Province is surrendered.

wars.name: Battle of Xiangyang (191)
wars.outcome: Sun Jian, sent against Liu Biao, was 'hit by an arrow and killed'; Liu Biao kept Jing Province.

wars.name: Cao Cao's southern campaign of 208
wars.outcome: Liu Biao died as the offensive began; Liu Cong surrendered Jing Province to Cao Cao; Cao Cao lost most of it to Liu Bei and Sun Quan after Red Cliffs.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary for Liu Biao; the shape is Hubei and Hunan as the Liu Biao page words it.
